notes.title: UPDATE 1.15
notes.notes:
We have launched a patch since some users have been reported problems with the timer in the campaign mode when dialogues are on screen.

Thank you for your time

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1
notes.notes:
Since some users have detected some troubles in their highscore when finishing SpeedRun Mode, we have just fix this bug and now SpeedRun Mode and its best time are working correctly.

We will be providing more updates soon.

Thank you!
